title: General Dynamics taps Primordial to build AI assistant for combat vehicle crews
summary: General Dynamics has partnered with Primordial Labs to develop an AI assistant for combat vehicle crews. This AI, named Anura, is designed to understand soldiers' voice commands and translate them into specific, non-lethal actions, functioning like a militarized voice assistant.

title: Could NASA’s SR-71 Blackbird Be Modified To Reach Mach 4?
summary: NASA is exploring the possibility of modifying the SR-71 Blackbird to achieve speeds beyond its known top speed, potentially reaching Mach 4. The SR-71's airframe is believed capable of higher speeds, and new engines could be key to pushing its limits.

title: Army issues just under $100M in application awards for NGC2 to 9 companies
summary: The U.S. Army has awarded nearly $100 million in contracts to nine companies for Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) core software applications. This initiative aims to provide a scalable and continuously trainable foundation for command and control across the force.

title: From directed energy to AI and hardening, JIATF-401 is widening counter-UAS options
summary: The Joint Interagency Task Force 401 (JIATF-401) is expanding its range of counter-Unmanned Aerial System (C-UAS) options. This includes exploring diverse solutions such as directed energy, artificial intelligence, and physical hardening, acknowledging that no single defense addresses the drone threat comprehensively.

title: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
summary: Speaking at Token2049 in Singapore, the chairman said Bitmine is about 100,000 ETH—roughly six to seven weeks—from its 5% cap, setting an end date on a buying spree that made it the world's largest Ethereum treasury.

title: Justin Drake urges crypto ‘bunker mode,’ as AI could break wallet security within months
summary: The Ethereum researcher said crypto users should consider moving funds to fresh addresses, warning AI could threaten private-key security before quantum computers do.

title: Ethereum Researcher Says AI May Break Encryption Before Quantum Does
summary: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake urged holders to calmly move funds to unused addresses, warning that AI-driven math could break crypto signatures before quantum computers do.
